gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that a {@link Symmetry454Date} can be used as a {@code TemporalAdjuster} to set the date portion of a {@link LocalDateTime}.
ADDED i2: The Symmetry454 date 2012-07-19 corresponds to the ISO date 2012-07-20.
ADDED i3: Adjusting LocalDateTime.MIN with the Symmetry454 date replaces only the date fields, leaving the time at midnight (00:00).
